Messages.Author: chrisn101
Messages.Body:
Name: Kyros of Antioch v1
Clan: Harbinger of Skulls
Level: Basic
Group: 3
Capacity: 10
Disciplines:
obf , thn , AUS , FOR , NEC

Once during you untap phase, Kyros may burn a blood for you to search your library for a Master: Discipline card and put it in your hand. Discard down to your handsize and shuffle your library afterwards. +1 intercept. +1 bleed.

Art notes: This vampire wears a giant eagle-shaped skull/mask/helmet.

World of Darkness reference:  WW Genealogy ; Antioch was founded by where an eagle sat to eat a piece of meat, hence the skull/mask/helmet design.

How does this card address a compelling game need?: Need for more HoS; allows greater Samedi/HoS mixed decks.

Created by:
Chris Nelson

Name: Alexia Theusa v1
Clan: Harbinger of Skulls
Level: Basic
Group: 3
Capacity: 10
Disciplines:
cel , thn , AUS , FOR , NEC , OBF

1 vote (titled). May enter combat with any minion not a Giovanni or Nosferatu as a D action. +1 strength.

Art notes: An extremely pale figure stands in partial shadow, looking animalistic.

World of Darkness reference:  WW Genealogy .

How does this card address a compelling game need?: Need for more HoS; allows greater Samedi/HoS mixed decks. Genealogy suggests this vampire was a skilled fighter.

Created by:
Chris Nelson

Name: Abraham v1
Clan: Harbinger of Skulls
Level: Basic
Group: 3
Capacity: 10
Disciplines:
AUS , FOR , NEC , OBF , THN

While you control Abraham, you have +1 hand size. Once during you untap phase, Abraham may burn a blood to allow you to search your library or ash heap for a location card and put it in your hand. Discard down to your handsize (if from your library, shuffle afterwards).

Art notes: A grey-cloaked figure bent over eldritch books.

World of Darkness reference:  WW Genealogy .

How does this card address a compelling game need?: Need for more HoS; allows greater Samedi/HoS mixed decks. Appears to be a scholar.

Created by:
Chris Nelson
